old=p.read_text()
new='''def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter

    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    background = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]

    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == background:
                continue
            for dr, dc in ((1, 1), (1, -1)):
                nr, nc = r + dr, c + dc
                if not (0 <= nr < h and 0 <= nc < w and grid[nr][nc] == color):
                    continue
                for er, ec, sr, sc in ((r, c, -dr, -dc), (nr, nc, dr, dc)):
                    pr, pc = er - sr, ec - sc
                    if 0 <= pr < h and 0 <= pc < w and grid[pr][pc] == color:
                        continue
                    if any(0 <= ar < h and 0 <= ac < w and grid[ar][ac] != background
                           for ar, ac in ((er - 1, ec), (er + 1, ec), (er, ec - 1), (er, ec + 1))):
                        continue
                    rr, cc = er + sr, ec + sc
                    while 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w and grid[rr][cc] == background:
                        out[rr][cc] = color
                        rr += sr
                        cc += sc
    return out
'''
assert old.count('def transform(grid):') == 1
